summary: Regression-tested Focus Buddy renderer in cat-only default mode. All 11 test cases from the review request PASSED. Cat-only boot, click-to-toggle, panel controls (presets/custom clamping), start hides panel, roaming state cycling, mid-session panel reopen with continuing countdown, pause behavior, reset to cat-only, 1-minute completion with streak increment and hidden panel, bubble dismiss, and preserved coat/sound extras all verified.

test_results.1_cat_only_default: PASS - .panel starts hidden; pixel-cat visible; no app-code console errors (only 2 CSP-blocked Cloudflare beacon inline scripts, ignored as infra noise)
test_results.2_click_toggle: PASS - first click opens panel (hidden=false), second click hides again
test_results.4_start_hides_panel: PASS - after Start, .panel becomes hidden; timer ticks (45:00 -> 44:58); cat class transitions (walk observed)
test_results.5_roaming_alternation: PASS - sampled cat class over ~15s: [walk, idle, sit, stretch, idle] -> 4 unique states
test_results.6_click_during_study_reopens: PASS - clicking cat reopens panel; countdown continues (44:43 -> 44:41)
test_results.7_pause: PASS - Start button becomes 'Resume', countdown frozen at 44:41, bubble shows 'Taking a tiny break 🐾'
test_results.8_reset: PASS - clock restored to 45:00, .panel hidden, bubble 'Ready when you are!'
test_results.9_completion_1min: PASS - after ~65s: bubble 'Study session complete! 🎉 You studied for 1 minute!', .panel remains hidden, streak-count 0 -> 1
test_results.11_preserved_extras: PASS - coat-black toggles app-coat-black, coat-orange toggles app-coat-orange, coat-gray removes both; sound-toggle flips 'on' class (true -> false)

critical_code_review_comments: index.html CSP is strict ('script-src self') which is correct for the Electron packaged app; the two CSP errors in browser are from the preview proxy injecting a Cloudflare beacon inline script — infra noise only, no fix needed on app side.
app.js binds mousemove/mouseup on window, which is fine, but `drag` never resets if mouseup happens outside any listener case — currently handled correctly. No issues found.
seed_data_creation: localStorage cleared before streak test as instructed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static server serves /app/focus-buddy/src at https://pomo-pal.preview.emergentagent.com/index.html. Electron-only features (window movement, resize IPC via window.focusBuddy) are correctly guarded and absent in browser — do not flag. All renderer-side cat-only mode logic works as specified.
